snippet.description:
After being captured and taken to the nether by ClownPierce... I was put into a Mining Prison, where players must mine for their own survival. But I promise that someday, somehow, I'm going to escape. This is How 1000 Players Simulate Mining Prison in Minecraft. 

Unstable SMP:
➜ ‪  ‪    ‪@FlameFragsMC 
➜       ‪@Spokeishere 
➜     ‪‪  @wemmbumc 
➜       ‪@ParrotX2 

Like ParrotX2 and his Unstable SMP series, where he is escaping Paragon / Proton: Minecraft's Most Secure Prison, or got hunted by a Minecraft Player who doesn't exist. This is a new and original Minecraft idea like HermitCraft or Lifesteal with Wemmbu, FlameFrags, or Spoke. Survival is harder than Hardcore Minecraft because PVP is on.

People in this video: @ClownPierce

snippet.title: SILO Season 4 Trailer Explained: Sneak Peek Preview Breakdown
snippet.description:
I review, breakdown and explain the Silo Season 4 Trailer. I give my reaction to the preview trailer and sneak peak for the final season of the show following Season 3 episode 10 being released and discuss Daniel and Helen meeting inside of The Digger Void which connects the Silo's, the flashback to Helen being in Silo 18, the first cleaning, Paul Billings speaking with the Silo, the reason Per Stenson created the Silo's and I also give my theories and predictions on how the show will end.

What is Roblox? ROBLOX is an online virtual playground and workshop, where kids of all ages can safely interact, create, have fun, and learn. It’s unique in that practically everything on ROBLOX is designed and constructed by members of the community.  Each player starts by choosing an avatar and giving it an identity. They can then explore ROBLOX — interacting with others by chatting, playing games, or collaborating on creative projects. Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation. There is no cost for this first plot of virtual land. By participating and by building cool stuff, ROBLOX members can earn specialty badges as well as ROBLOX dollars (“Robux”). In turn, they can shop the online catalog to purchase avatar clothing and accessories as well as premium building materials, interactive components, and working mechanisms.

snippet.title: Simulating a Criminal Empire on Hardcore Minecraft
snippet.description:
Me and my friends spent two weeks running a realistic Minecraft society server, and then removed every rule for one night. This modded Minecraft SMP had a real election with candidates and campaign promises, property tax and income tax, a town treasury, insurance you buy from the mayor, a sheriff with search warrants, DNA forensics that can tell you who placed a block, and consequences for anyone who fell behind. Miss your taxes and your base starts crumbling around you. Then on the final night the server flips to hardcore Minecraft, the laws stop applying, and everyone finds out what we knew from day one: every single player secretly drew a name at the start, and one of them drew mine. Almost four hours of Minecraft roleplay, elections, creative accounting, trail cameras, tape recorders, a courthouse, a rollercoaster, and one rare item that took the whole town apart before the final night even arrived.

snippet.title: Harry Potter Isn't Book-Accurate Anymore
snippet.description:
Grab a cold one, ya pelicans. Today we’re sitting down to rip into the brand-new HBO Harry Potter trailer shot-by-shot.
First they promised us an adaptation strictly "faithful" to the sacred texts—now the suits are doing the corporate downgrade ladder and calling it "Novels Plus". Plus what? Plus whatever fan-fiction they cooked up on a lunch break?
We break down the good, the bad, and the genuinely cooked: from book-accurate eagle crests and proper Herbology lessons to John Lithgow sounding like an angry American high school football coach, Nick Frost’s Hagrid, blind bathroom trolls, and Lily and James apparently burning down bridges on date night. Is this actually going to honor the books, or are we staring down another corporate trainwreck like Google Plus?

Drop a comment below with your thoughts—is "Novels Plus" code for total disaster, or are you actually keen?

BECOME A MEMBER to hear the completely uncensored, filthy versions of every breakdown.

snippet.title: Anime “Dragon Ball Super: Beerus” | Super Surge Trailer
snippet.description:
The God of Destruction Beerus, Frieza, and now —
A new threat closing in on Earth, stands in the way of Goku and his allies.

October 2026
Broadcasting and streaming begins!
The anime Dragon Ball Super, original work, story, and character design by Akira Toriyama, is set to begin anew as Dragon Ball Super: Beerus!

#dragonball #dragonballsuper

◾️Anime “Dragon Ball Super: Beerus” | SUPER Launch Trailer
https://youtu.be/OOmRInABehI

◾️Anime “Dragon Ball Super: Beerus” | SUPER GEKITOU Trailer
https://youtu.be/-NekKfJN614

◾️INTRODUCTION
The globally beloved manga DRAGON BALL by Akira Toriyama continues to captivate fans through a wide range of media—from TV animation, movies, games, and merchandising—standing as a top-ranked title with extraordinary worldwide popularity. 
Now, in 2026, the anime Dragon Ball Super, original work, story, and character design by Akira Toriyama, is set to begin anew as Dragon Ball Super: Beerus! This ENHANCED edition introduces a large volume of newly added and redrawn cuts, as well as a reconstructed narrative. With cutting-edge visual expression, the series delivers even more immersive battle scenes and a more faithful representation of the original manga—bringing an ENHANCED edition to life like never before.

Several years have passed since the fierce battle against Majin Buu, and Earth has finally regained a brief moment of peace. At the same time, Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakens from his long, deep sleep. Even Kai and Supreme Kai, aware of Beerus’s overwhelming power to destroy entire planets, watch his awakening with great fear… Meanwhile, Beerus hears rumors of a Saiyan who defeated Frieza—and suddenly appears before Goku.
Targeted by Beerus, the strongest being in the universe, Earth is in grave danger. Thus begins an Earth-shattering cosmic battle between the God of Destruction and Goku and his allies—a conflict that will shake the entire universe.


Original Work, Story & Character Design: Akira Toriyama
Composition and Direction Arrangement: Matsuto Seya
Animation Character Design & General Animation Director: Tadayoshi Yamamuro
Editing: Eichi Nishimura
Compositing Director: Yosuke Motoki
Music: Norihito Sumitomo

OPENING THEME　"ONOGAMI"　MEGATERA･ZERO

Free Cover es una banda nacida en Venezuela en 2017, fundada por el guitarrista Neg y el tecladista Chompa. La banda reúne a músicos y amigos unidos por la pasión por los grandes clásicos de nuestra música. ¿Y mi baby?

Baby, wow, me gustas demasia'o
Bebé

Dime, dime, baby, cómo hacer que tu boca

Uh, baby, wow
Me gustas demasia'o (Yeah, yeah, oh)

[Verso 2: KAROL G]
De noche y de día te pasas rondando mi mente

Porque no está el que yo quería

Esa boquita, es que tú ere' my dream come true
Si la pasamo' hijuepu, es que la pasamo' bien

Pa' estar juntos en verano y también en diciembre
Yo sé que tú no lo dices, pero estás pendiente
Vamo' a darnos otro chance, puede que haya suerte
Dime si lo siente', es que yo

[Pre-Coro: Judeline]
Voy manejando por la ciudad
Por si nos vemo' de casualidad

snippet.title: State of Play | September 3, 2026 [English]
snippet.description:
State of Play returns Thursday, September 3 with two broadcasts airing back-to-back.

First, tune in for a new State of Play featuring updates and announcements from PlayStation Studios and our third-party partners, concluding with an extended look at the vast world of Final Fantasy VII Revelation from our friends at Square Enix.

Immediately following, stay tuned for a new episode of State of Play Japan, once again hosted by Yuki Kaji. State of Play Japan will offer deep dives into upcoming games from game studios in Japan and Asia, including new gameplay, announcements, and more.

Watch both broadcasts live on September 3 starting at 6:00am PT / 9:00am ET / 3:00pm CEST / 10:00pm JST on YouTube and Twitch. State of Play will air in English, with Japanese subtitles also available. State of Play Japan will air in Japanese, with English subtitles available.

See you there.

snippet.title: Wake Island: The Last Stand That Stunned Japan
snippet.description:
Follow and Wishlist our game on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/3606970?utm_source=0244

December 1941. It’s the early days of the Pacific War and Wake Island – a small atoll in the middle of the Pacific Ocean – is enduring daily raids by Japanese bombers. The defenders must rely on half-finished fortifications, outdated coastal guns, the four surviving planes of USMC Fighter Squadron 211, some AA guns that have AA directors, the help of civilian builders, and sheer determination. The poorly equipped but well-trained marines are busily preparing for the worst.

On December 11th, a Japanese landing force under Rear Admiral Kajioka sails closer to Wake Island, determined to obtain this atoll as a forward air base for the Imperial Japanese Navy. The bomber pilots have reported that over the last three days they have leveled the defences there, so not much resistance is to be expected.

Sources:
1. R. D. Heinl Jr. The Defense of Wake. U.S. Marine Corps, 1947
2. J. P. S. Devereux The Story of Wake Island. NY, 1947
3. R. J. Cressman A Magnificent Fight: Marines in the Battle for Wake Island. Naval Institute Press 1997
4. G. R. Cunningham Tactical Effectiveness of Naval Aviation at https://www.historycentral.com/navy/stories/Cuningham.html
5. https://www.history.navy.mil/research/library/online-reading-room/title-list-alphabetically/n/narrative-of-captain-ws-cunningham-us-navy-relative-to-events-o-wake-island-in-december-1941-and-subsequent-related-events.html
6. John F. Kinney, Wake Island Pilot: A World War II Memoir. Sterling, VA: Potomac Books, 2005
